title: Quantum Cognition Machine Learning for Forecasting Chromosomal Instability
abstract: arXiv:2506.03199v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The accurate prediction of chromosomal instability from the morphology of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) enables real-time detection of CTCs with high metastatic potential in the context of liquid biopsy diagnostics. However, it presents a significant challenge due to the high dimensionality and complexity of single-cell digital pathology data. Here, we introduce the application of Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML), a quantum-inspired computational framework, to estimate morphology-predicted chromosomal instability in CTCs from patients with metastatic breast cancer. QCML leverages quantum mechanical principles to represent data as state vectors in a Hilbert space, enabling context-aware feature modeling, dimensionality reduction, and enhanced generalization without requiring curated feature selection. translated_title: 用于预测染色体不稳定性的量子认知机器学习
translated_abstract: 基于循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）形态学对染色体不稳定性进行准确预测，能够在液体活检诊断的背景下实现对具有高转移潜力CTC的实时检测。然而，由于单细胞数字病理学数据的高维度和复杂性，这构成了重大挑战。在此，我们介绍了量子认知机器学习（QCML）——一种量子启发的计算框架——的应用，用于估计转移性乳腺癌患者CTC中基于形态学预测的染色体不稳定性。QCML利用量子力学原理将数据表示为希尔伯特空间中的状态向量，实现上下文感知的特征建模、降维以及增强的泛化能力，且无需人工精选的特征选择。在样本外验证CTC的测试中，QCML优于传统机器学习方法，取得了更高的
tldr: 本文提出量子认知机器学习（QCML）框架，利用量子力学原理将单细胞形态数据表示为希尔伯特空间中的状态向量，无需人工特征选择即可从转移性乳腺癌患者的循环肿瘤细胞形态中预测染色体不稳定性，并在样本外验证中优于传统机器学习方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML), a quantum-inspired framework that represents single-cell morphology data as state vectors in Hilbert space, enabling prediction of chromosomal instability in CTCs from metastatic breast cancer patients without curated feature selection, outperforming conventional machine learning methods in out-of-sample validation.
